not_false_positive: The source does write a plaintext temporary password; scanner evidence is factually true.
impact: Archived isolated test-bootstrap mechanism, no committed secret values or production/browser persistence. Reading requires access inside an atomically-created0700 temporary parent. Root, sameUID and OSACL trust are explicit local-host assumptions.
controls: Fresh256-bit random per-run password; external credentials/DATABASE_URL excluded from inherited test environment.
Owned loopback-only SCRAM disposable PostgreSQL; no live DB/institution/Company authority binding.
tempfile.mkdtemp atomically creates0700 parent; password file chmod0600 before initdb; pre-chmod interval remains protected by parent.
Plaintext file lifetime is initdb bootstrap only: bounded120-second initdb thenunlink before server start; ordinary exceptions leave TemporaryDirectory cleanup.
Successful run receipts and logs independently show stop0, exact directory absence and recorded postmaster absence.
Full selected evidence streams contain source generation code, not actual passwords; diagnostics scrub generated secret strings.
Production build manifest includes no docs; finalDocker copies only staged runtime allowlist; no CI execution path to docs runner snapshots.
limits: Hardkill/powerloss can leave an owner-only disposable credential; no cryptographic erasure or process-memory claim.
This is not a blanket dismissal of password storage in production, client stores, logs or live delegated-credential stores.
A stdin pipe bootstrap is a reasonable future active-harness simplification; changing immutable historical source solely to silence alerts is not warranted.
PR CodeQL Python/JS analysis uses overlay-changes;0results does not prove preexisting main alerts fixed.
